description: This file is a C/C++ header file for the TensorFlow Java JNI bindings related to the server component, defining external JNI functions for server lifecycle management.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Server_allocate
methods.description: Allocates a new server instance from a byte array definition.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Server_start
methods.description: Starts the server instance identified by a long handle.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Server_stop
methods.description: Stops the server instance identified by a long handle.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Server_join
methods.description: Joins the server thread identified by a long handle.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Server_delete
methods.description: Deletes or cleans up the server instance identified by a long handle.
